about: The media vault of the productions pages: images and videos too big for the website go here, not into the site's repository (Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026). The read key below is published on purpose: anyone may read the vault; only its keeper can write. With sgit: sgit clone <read_key>:<vault_id> against the endpoint.
vault_key: Not here. Held by the keeper in its session; a copy sealed to c.maestro goes upstream.
